g.aria-label: Market and company units with market share overlay

g.text: Market share = company units / total-market units. Bars: left axis. Share line: right axis.
ASP = revenue / units, calculated separately for company and total market (including company).
Fictional data and routing. New portfolio demonstration; no live Qlik connection.
